description: Ministry of Defence - Order to declare that the Extradition Law between Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation
categorisation: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring that the provisions of the Extradition Law No. 8 of 1977 shall apply to the Russian Federation based on a bilateral treaty. It establishes a legal framework for extradition between countries, which falls under legal/regulatory matters concerning international legal cooperation and the application of domestic law to foreign states.
